sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer
SELECT T2.Name FROM Artist AS T1 JOIN Album AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM Artist AS T1 JOIN Genre AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(T2.GenreId) > 1

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(t.Total) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine t
JOIN Invoice i ON t.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2022'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.InvoiceDate);
SELECT SUM(population) AS combined_population, YEAR FROM countries GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY YEAR

SELECT income_group, SUM(gdp_usd) AS total_gdp
FROM country_stats
WHERE year = 2023
GROUP BY income_group
ORDER BY total_gdp DESC
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2023 AND T2.internet_users_pct < 10 AND T2.internet_users_pct > 50
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE bill_length_mm > (SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins)
SELECT T2.Country FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID WHERE T1.Age > 40 AND T1.Age < 30
SELECT MAX(MPG) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year < 1980
SELECT count(*) FROM employee
SELECT T2.Paragraph_ID, T2.Paragraph_Text FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T1.Document_Name = 'Welcome to NY'
SELECT AVG(winner_age) AS avg_winner_age, AVG(loser_age) AS avg_loser_age FROM matches
SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_name FROM Student_Enrolment AS T1 JOIN Semesters AS T2 ON T1.semester_id = T2.semester_id WHERE T1.student_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poker_player
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Code) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = 'English' AND T2.Language = 'Dutch'
SELECT h.name, COUNT(l.student_id) FROM Highschooler h JOIN Likes l ON h.id = l.highest_schooler_id GROUP BY h.name

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN (SELECT T2.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 WHERE T2.name NOT IN (SELECT T1.first_name FROM Owners AS T1))
